carry_overs_open.git_check_ignore_negation_trap: NEW 2026-10-16, found during P069's build and confirmed by the coordinator. git check-ignore exits 0 whenever ANY pattern matched, INCLUDING a negation pattern, so a fixture check that reads only the exit status reports a deliberately re-included file as ignored. Root .gitignore line 60 (!products/*/fixtures/**/junit.xml) is exactly such a negation. This session's own sweep parses the matched pattern and treats a leading ! as not-ignored. Any check that trusts the exit code alone is wrong; worth a one-line fix in scripts/cold_clone_check.py if it uses it.
